notes.title: "Tank Arena" Update Announcement for September 22 - Version 6.5.0 Is Here
notes.notes:
"Tank Arena" is scheduled to undergo server maintenance from 15:00 on September 22 to update to version 6.5.0. The update is expected to take approximately 6 hours. Thank you for your understanding and support!



I. New Chief Domination Gameplay

To enhance competition within single-branch vehicles, this update introduces the new Chief Domination mode (limited-time event). Engage in Brawl battles using single-branch vehicles to earn Chief Domination Honor, vehicle/equipment upgrade materials, and compete for server-wide rankings (reset monthly). Exclusive titles await top performers!

Gameplay Details:

1. Open Times: Daily 10:00-14:00 and 20:00-22:00.

2. Rules:

① Vehicles are divided into three types: Tanks (MLRS), AFVs, and Helis. Each match allows 6 players.

② Pre-set three same-branch vehicles. Enter the battlefield in sequence—when destroyed, the next vehicle deploys. Battle ends when all vehicles are destroyed or opponents are defeated (or when time expires).

③ Battle Score is calculated based on performance (damage, kills, etc.). Rankings determine points: Top 4 gain points, bottom 2 lose points.

④ Powerful buffs (e.g., healing, attack boosts) spawn periodically. Seize them to gain advantages!

⑤ Ranking rewards are settled monthly. Participate in all three branches, but only the highest Rank reward can be claimed once across all branches (no duplicate rewards).

⑥ First 10 daily battles grant Honor and drop rewards (exchangeable in the Domination Store). Beyond 10 battles, no rewards but Rank points are earned.

⑦ Weekly participation milestones unlock additional task rewards.

"⑧ Top 10 players receive limited-time titles:

Rank 1: Chief Title;

Ranks 2-3: Vice-Chief Title;

Ranks 4-10: Top 10 Title"

Ⅱ. New Title System

After obtaining a title, activate and equip it via your profile page. Some titles feature broadcast functionality—when entering battlefields or forming teams, all players will be notified.

New Titles (All titles are time-limited.):

1. Chief Domination Rank 1 Title (with broadcast feature)

2. Chief Domination Ranks 2-3 Title (with broadcast feature)

3. Chief Domination Ranks 4-10 Title

4. Chief Domination Participation Title (complete weekly Domination tasks to claim)

Ⅲ. New Commander Supply

To help commanders more easily obtain commanders and their development materials, this update introduces the Commander Supply feature. Supply Coupons can be acquired through events and the in-game store.

Commander Supply Pool Details:

1. Pool Contents:

① Complete Commanders

② Commander Memory Pages

③ Commander Advancement Medals

④ Commander Upgrade Materials

⑤ Commander Points

2. Base Reward: Every 10-draw guarantees a random commander from the pool.

3. Themed Event: Each event features a themed commander. Reaching the 10-draw count guarantees the current themed commander.

4. Score Store: Participate in supplies to earn Commander Points, which can be used to purchase corresponding items.

Ⅳ. Command Post Fusion

To allow commanders to utilize better equipment attributes, this update introduces the Command Post Equipment Fusion feature.

2. Two max-tier red 5★ equipment pieces of the same slot can be fused together—designated as Primary Equipment and Material Equipment. One attribute from the Material Equipment can be transferred to the Main Equipment. After successful fusion, the Material Equipment is destroyed.

2. Each Material Equipment can only transfer one attribute. Without using Fusion Protection Materials, fusion failure will destroy the Material Equipment.

3. Fusion success rates vary based on the color (rarity) of the transferred attribute. During fusion, Fusion Protection can be applied to safeguard the Material Equipment—if fusion fails, the Material Equipment is not destroyed. After accumulating a certain number of attempts, the next fusion is guaranteed to succeed.

Note: Fusion Protection Materials can be purchased in the Trade Store or acquired via packages. Commanders should carefully read the feature instructions and fuse cautiously!

V. Strategy

This update adds 5 new layers to the Commander Strategy.

Ⅵ. Legion Optimizations

This update brings the following optimizations to the Legion system:

1. Increased capacity for resource distribution

2. Resource distribution records now reset weekly (cleared when Legion Boss refreshes)

3. Vice Legion Commanders now have the authority to expel members

4. Added Legion disband function: Legion Commanders can choose to disband the Legion. Legions Level 9 and below will automatically disband if all members are inactive for 14 days.

5. Legion Boss challenges are limited to one team at a time. Other teams can challenge only after the current team exits.

Ⅶ. Other Optimizations

1. Optimized Painting Store's texture and model buttons for easier switching between textures and models.

2. Guaranteed orange or red blueprint in every 10-draw blueprint supply.

3. Duplicate commanders will no longer be converted into Advancement Medals but into an equal amount of Memory Pages. The functionality for using Memory Pages will be introduced later.

4. Added preparation features to the Legion War team formation page.

5. Added preparation features to the Brawl matchmaking page.

6. Fixed other known issues.

notes.title: "Tank Arena" August 4th Update Notice
notes.notes:
Dear Commander,

"Tank Arena" servers will undergo maintenance for an update on August 4th, 2025, at 15:00 (server time). The process is expected to take 5 hours, during which the game will be temporarily unavailable.

This update includes gameplay optimizations and new event content. We appreciate your patience and support. Thank you, and enjoy the game!

 

I. MLRS Adjustments

To align with MLRS vehicles' battlefield role, this update optimizes MLRS series with positioning enhancements and matchmaking rule adjustments (now allowing ±1 MLRS per match):

1. MLRS Changes:

① New Weapon: Deployable Emitter that drops repair kits (30s duration). Allies triggering kits restore durability.

② Increased vehicle durability

③ Increased vehicle speed

④ Reduced MLRS weapon damage

⑤ Reduced MLRS range

2. Howitzer Changes:

① New Weapon: Mortar that creates AOE damage with Armor Broken effect (reduces enemy armor strength).

② Increased vehicle durability

③ Increased vehicle speed

④ Reduced howitzer damage

⑤ Reduced howitzer range

Weapon Acquisition: Emitters/Mortars available via Logistic Weapon Supply and Limited bundles in event.

Upgrade materials: Ranked Honor Store and direct purchases.

 

Ⅱ. Rank Mode Updates

1. Rank teaming: Weekend events (Sat-Sun) now allow dual same-type vehicles (Tank/AFV only).

2. Honor Hall: Monthly vehicle usage counters reset after lock-in.

3. Deserter penalty: Hero-tier deserters lose 2★.

4. Loss protection: Reduced star loss scales with consecutive defeats.

5. Rank first win: Increased from 1 to 3 wins/day.

6. Season timing: Ends on month’s penultimate day (Feb: 28 days).

7. AFK detection: Improved decision rules.

 

Ⅲ. New Warrant

1. 2025 Season 3 Rank Warrant

2. August Rank Warrant

3. Peak Warrant: Added past painting purchases (duplicates convert to 1000 coating; flags/decals to 300 coating).

Note: Rank Warrant weekly missions reset monthly (4-week cycles).*

 

Ⅳ. Cross-Server Endless Battle

Added cross-server teaming for Endless Battle. CN-server players can now team up via dedicated channels for bonus rewards.

 

Ⅴ. Ranked Maps

All ranked maps are now available.

 

Ⅵ. Other Optimizations

1. Endless Mode: Server errors no longer consume attempt counts.

2. Fixed tank auto-minelaying bugs.

3. Fixed sporadic second Commander skill failures.

4. Other known issues resolved.
